a.lede: Attackers are actively exploiting vulnerabilities across critical network infrastructure, and PHP flaws known as "PHP2Shell" put the web management interfaces of firewalls, VPNs, application delivery controllers, and other appliances at risk. [...]
a.title: InfraTrust report warns of exploited flaws in critical network infrastructure

b.lede: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned federal agencies to patch a high-severity Linux kernel privilege escalation bug that attackers are chaining with the PHP2Shell flaws in the wild. [...]
b.title: CISA warns of Fragnesia Linux flaw chained in PHP2Shell attacks
